name: acemode
description: Local-first AI-assisted video production desktop workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 npm run electron:start"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
